sentences.en: I have high cholesterol and I need to avoid saturated fats.
sentences.zh: 我胆固醇偏高，需要避免饱和脂肪。

sentences.en: Kaleidoscopic prints saturate my blank mind, creating vital memories and burning thoughts.
sentences.zh: 万花筒般的图案填满了我的空白心灵，创造出鲜活的记忆并燃烧着思绪。

sentences.en: The sky in this photo is very saturated.
sentences.zh: 这张照片中的天空色彩非常浓郁。
